# GSAP 3.13.0

Unmodified distribution files from the official `gsap` npm package, served locally
so analytics animation does not wait for a third-party request on viewport entry.

- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.13.0/dist/gsap.min.js
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.13.0/dist/ScrollTrigger.min.js
- License: https://gsap.com/standard-license/

The original copyright and license headers are retained in both scripts.
